_recipe.title: Hiring post
_recipe.when: Announce an open role on LinkedIn / Instagram feed (4:5): startups, agencies, clinics, restaurants, any team that's hiring.
beats: Hook: "We're hiring" + the role + location/remote, readable at a glance.
Mission: what the team builds and for whom, three short kinetic lines.
The job: three things this person will do, as numbered lines.
Perks: four tiles with the real benefits (pay band first if you can share it).
Team proof: team size or a number candidates care about.
Voice of the team: a real quote from someone on the team.
copyTips: Role, location, work mode, salary band, perks and team size come from the hiring manager. Leave a perk out rather than guess.
Use plain job language ("Build our Android app"), not buzzwords ("rockstar ninja"); inclusive wording widens the pool.
Sharing the pay range in the perks beat gets noticeably more qualified applicants; suggest it.
The team quote must be real and approved by the person quoted.
Corporate + smooth reads trustworthy on LinkedIn. Creative studios: --theme editorial. Restaurants / retail: --theme pop.
